representation_fit.evidence: Primary object change_set is represented literally: left column is a timeline of 7 release windows v2.8.0→v2.9.1 (screenshot 1440x900, left rail; source/data.js:38-140), mid column replays fleet state at the selected window with inline old→new diffs (screenshot 1440x900 shows '0.8.4 → 0.9.0', '15min → 30min'; source/app.js:76-89,200-209), right column lists the window's changes with parent/child causal links plus a chain panel (screenshot 1280x860 right; app.js:237-301). High-temporality/many/medium-density facets (brief.md shape table) are each addressed.

primary_task_salience.evidence: Brief verb 'understand evolving state' is the dominant content of the initial screen: subtitle states '服务舰队随时间的状态演化 · 变更因果可读' (index.html:13, visible both screenshots); largest area is timeline + state replay; state header counts changes and instructs '点选右侧变更可查看因果链' (app.js:177-180, visible in both screenshots).

time_to_understand.evidence: Model-judged label proxy: header, column titles (时间轴·变更集 index.html:30; 舰队状态 @ v2.9.1 · date app.js:178-180; 发布窗口 v2.9.1 app.js:270) and green validation chip '✓ … · 21 项变更 · 4 条因果链' (both screenshots, app.js:121-131) make what/where legible immediately; default lands on latest window with data inlined, no loading state (app.js:115,362-377).

navigation_cost.evidence: Zero modes/pages: latest change set is on screen at load; any other window is 1 click on the timeline (app.js:342-343), 1 click on a per-service window square (app.js:211-220,213), arrow keys (app.js:356-360), replay buttons (index.html:31-37), or deep link ?w=&c=&trace=1 (app.js:368-374).

context_loss.evidence: Single persistent three-pane layout; window/selection changes re-render in place with timeline and state header retained (app.js:303-323; styles.css:73 sticky state-head); trace mode highlights across windows without leaving the view (app.js:319-324, styles.css:89,47). Minor deliberate resets — selecting another window/change clears trace (app.js:308-318) — do not displace the user.

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Permanent controls total 5 replay buttons plus clickable timeline items/cards/squares (index.html:31-40); no search/filter/settings or decorative surfaces; per-window metric tiles and timeline metrics serve the evolution-comprehension job (app.js:239-242,153-156). Surface scales with the brief's 'many/medium density' shape.

accessibility.evidence: Receipt: a11y.contrast=fail, a11y.focus_order=fail, type.min_projected_size=fail, a11y.target_size=pass (measurement-summary.json checks). Structural correlates in source: per-service window squares are non-focusable <i> elements (app.js:213,218; styles.css:106 cursor:pointer) reachable only by mouse; no :focus/:focus-visible rule exists anywhere in styles.css; sub-11px type is widespread (styles.css:127 and 154 at 9.5px; 58 and 65 at 10px; kbd-hint 10.5px at opacity .75, styles.css:39). Keyboard shortcuts ←/→/Esc and semantic <button> timeline/change items are positives (app.js:146-157,257-266,356-360), but 2 of 3 a11y checks fail.

frontend_rework.evidence: No visible layout defects at either viewport and layout.overflow=pass, layout.responsive_collision=pass, text.truncation=pass (measurement-summary.json; screenshots 1280x860 and 1440x900 are clean, legacy service correctly dimmed '已于 v2.9.0 下线' at 1440x900). Rework is implied only by the 3 failing checks (contrast, focus order, min type size), which are a11y/typography-class rather than layout breakage — hence 4 not 5. Error receipt referenced objectively: 4 pass / 3 fail / 0 skipped, target_invalid=false.

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed '时间结构与变更语义一致' is both represented and enforced: app.js:37-73 validate() checks causal ordering (parent must precede child in window sequence) and replays the timeline asserting each modify's from matches live state and add/remove presence, run on every load (app.js:363-366) with the pass chip visible in both screenshots; data satisfies it — e.g. auth 令牌 TTL baseline 15min (data.js:27) modified to 30min at w6 (data.js:136) matches the rendered card diff in screenshot 1440x900, and legacy-report remove at w5 (data.js:116) matches its dimmed card.

defects_observed: a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order and type.min_projected_size all fail in the receipt (measurement-summary.json checks)
Interactive window-squares per service card are <i> elements, not focusable/keyboard-operable (source/app.js:213,218)
No :focus/:focus-visible styling anywhere in source/styles.css, so keyboard focus is invisible
Sub-11px text used broadly (source/styles.css:127,154 = 9.5px; :58,:65 = 10px) and kbd-hint at 10.5px with opacity .75 (styles.css:39)
At 1280x860 the mid column collapses to one card per row, leaving only ~4 of 10 services above the fold (screenshot 1280x860)
scores.overall_note: This package is a three-pane Fleet Chronicle whose representation matches the brief almost exactly: a timeline of seven release-window change sets (data.js:38-140), in-place state replay with inline old→new diffs, and a causal-chain panel wired via parent links, directly serving the understand×temporal-sequence job and the change_set primary object. The acceptance seed is not merely depicted but actively validated at load (app.js:37-73) with the pass state surfaced in the header chip visible in both screenshots, and rendered diffs cross-check against the data (e.g. auth TTL 15min→30min). Navigation cost is minimal (single view, one-click/arrow-key window switching, deep links) and no layout defects are visible at 1280x860 or 1440x900 (layout checks all pass). The clear weakness is accessibility: three of seven receipt checks fail, with structural correlates in source (mouse-only <i> squares, no focus styles, 9.5–11px type), implying rework for keyboard-first or low-vision use. These judgments are structural and model-judged proxies from static evidence; they are not a substitute for human preference or task-time measurement, which this blind pilot does not observe.
